title: ==TESTING ENGINEER==  ·  MANUAL & AUTOMATION · AI-DRIVEN APPLICATIONS

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Testing engineer with **4.8 years of experience** in manual and automation testing, with a genuine **interest in AI testing**. Designed and executed test cases, reported bugs, and built automated suites with Playwright and Selenium BDD. Actively applied **AI prompting for QA** — creating workflows that generate test ideas and edge cases — and designed an AI-assisted test case generator on Jira.
